integrity: Mathematical proof supplied in RESULT.md; finite standard-library verifier is corroborative, not a substitute for the proof. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Counts all dissociation sets (induced degree at most one) of rectangular rook graphs, not maximal sets alone; it does not solve the sub-quorum colouring number. The maximum-size part for near-balanced boards is partly prior-implied by a 2011 Hamiltonian-path line-graph theorem. Independent mathematical audit and exhaustive historical priority review are outstanding. The 6-by-6 maximum and optimal count are already known from PUMaC 2010 Problem 7.
title: Complete dissociation polynomial and sharp occupancy threshold for rook graphs
